description: Portrait of a male human fighter, late 20s, battle-scarred face, short dark beard, wearing chain mail hauberk and carrying a heater shield, longsword at hip. Hard watchful eyes, compact muscular build. Wild Coast mercenary look.

Portrait of a female human cleric of Pelor, early 20s, auburn hair in a practical braid, wearing chain mail with a golden sun medallion over it, mace at belt. Earnest warm expression, clear grey eyes, slight build. Young acolyte, not yet worn by the world.

Portrait of a male halfling thief, apparent age mid-20s (halfling), curly red hair, bright mischievous green eyes, wide roguish grin showing a chipped tooth. Wearing supple leather armour with many small pockets, short sword at hip. Small and wiry, quick-looking, slightly dusty.

Portrait of a female human magic-user, mid-20s, dark olive skin, sharp intelligent dark eyes, black hair pulled back with a quill tucked in it, ink stains on her fingers. Plain dark travelling robes, a well-worn spellbook tucked under one arm, small dagger at belt. Quietly intense expression.
